title: 第九十八章  输麻了
slug: 替弟入赘后我被女帝赖上了
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

“痛快。”

严腾抚掌大笑。

“既然是赌，那自然得有点彩头。”

严腾伸出三根手指，在李少云面前晃了晃。

“三千两一局，李少将军觉得如何？”

三千两，这绝对不是一个小数目，甚至可以说是豪赌了。

周围围观的世家子弟们纷纷倒吸了一口凉气。

赵知武在顾淮耳边低声说道：

“这严腾显然是有备而来，那匹红马看起来不太对劲，李少云怕是要吃亏。”

顾淮微微点头，他自然也看出了端倪。

那匹赤焰神气完足，四肢关节的爆发力显然还在黑风驹之上。

但李少云此时已经被愤怒冲昏了头脑，根本听不进劝。

而且，自己老爹的黑风驹还从未有过败绩呢！还会怕了一匹名不见经传的马不成？

“三千两就三千两，老子跟你赌了。”

李少云咬着牙，大声喝道。

很快，马场的管事便飞快地将这场对决安排了下去。

整个麓山马场瞬间沸腾了。

黑风驹对阵赤焰，这绝对是今日最精彩的一场对决。

无数的银票纷纷砸向了庄家。

只不过，这一次两匹马的赔率相差无几，显然大家都在观望。

顾淮想了想，最终还是没有把那一千两押上去。

他有一种直觉，李少云这次要栽。

“铛。”

随着锣声响起，两匹神驹如同离弦之箭般冲出了起点。

一开始，黑风驹凭借着丰富的经验，隐隐占据了半个身位的优势。

李少云见状，脸上顿时露出了得意的大笑。

“哈哈，严腾，瞧见没有，老子的马就是比你的快。”

李少云大呼小叫着。

严腾却只是冷冷地看着赛道，脸上不见丝毫慌乱。

就在两匹马跑到赛道过半的时候，异变突生。

只见那匹赤焰突然发出一声高亢的嘶鸣，浑身肌肉瞬间紧绷。

它的速度在刹那间提升到了一个恐怖的地步。

“唰。”

赤焰如同一团燃烧的烈火，瞬间抹平了与黑风驹的差距。

不仅如此，它还在以一种肉眼可见的速度，将黑风驹甩在身后。

“这怎么可能？”

Page (1/3)

"Happy."

Yan Teng clapped his hands and laughed.

"Since it's a bet, there must be some luck."

Yan Teng stretched out three fingers and waved them in front of Li Shaoyun.

"Three thousand two rounds, what do you think, Major General Li?"

Three thousand taels, this is definitely not a small amount, it can even be said to be a huge gamble.

The disciples of the aristocratic families who were watching around took a breath of cold air.

Zhao Zhiwu whispered in Gu Huai's ear:

"Yan Teng obviously came prepared. That red horse doesn't look right. Li Shaoyun is afraid that he will suffer a loss."

Gu Huai nodded slightly, and he naturally saw the clues.

The red flame horse is full of energy, and the explosive power of its limb joints is obviously still higher than that of the black wind horse.

But Li Shaoyun was overwhelmed by anger at this time and couldn't listen to the advice at all.

Moreover, my father's Black Wind Horse has never been defeated!Are you still afraid of an unknown horse?

"Three thousand taels is three thousand taels, I'll make a bet with you."

Li Shaoyun gritted his teeth and shouted loudly.

Soon, the steward of the racecourse quickly arranged the duel.

The entire Lushan Racecourse was boiling instantly.

Black Wind Horse versus Chi Yan, this is definitely the most exciting showdown today.

Countless banknotes were thrown at the dealer.

However, this time the odds of the two horses are almost the same, so everyone is obviously waiting and watching.

Gu Huai thought for a while, but finally did not put down the one thousand taels.

He had an intuition that Li Shaoyun was going to fall into trouble this time.

"Clang."

As the gong sounded, the two divine horses rushed out of the starting point like arrows from the string.

At the beginning, Hei Fengju had a vague half-position advantage due to his rich experience.

When Li Shaoyun saw this, a proud smile suddenly appeared on his face.

"Haha, Yan Teng, did you see that my horse is faster than yours?"

Li Shaoyun shouted.

Yan Teng, however, just looked at the track coldly, with no trace of panic on his face.

Just when the two horses were halfway across the track, something happened suddenly.

I saw the red flame suddenly let out a high-pitched neigh, and the muscles all over its body tensed instantly.

Its speed increased to a terrifying level in an instant.

"Uh-huh."

The red flame was like a burning fire, instantly closing the gap with the black wind horse.

Not only that, it was also leaving the Black Wind Horse behind at a speed visible to the naked eye.

"How is this possible?"
